how.title: How a visit works
how.subtitle: A real stroll, like in a video game: pick your avatar and let yourself be guided.

station.title: The futuristic station
station.text: You step off the train and walk through a station lined with artworks.

cart.title: “Where are you going?”
cart.text: A driverless cart is waiting and takes you to the artist’s address.

wall.title: The entrance wall
wall.text: In the garden, a low wall shows the artist’s name, address and one artwork.

guide.title: The artist guides you
guide.text: Their avatar shows you around the halls and comments on every piece.

options.title: Visit, donate, or both
options.subtitle: In front of every gallery, the choice is yours. Every gesture supports an artist.

villa.title: Villa of the week
villa.subtitle: Every week, one artist’s villa in the spotlight.
villa.description: A painter of village life in Mali, Aminata Traoré hangs her canvases in three light-filled halls. Her avatar welcomes you in the garden and tells the story of every painting.

exhibit.title: Exhibit your art in your own villa
exhibit.text: Open your account, hang your works in the frames of your choice and reach visitors worldwide. You decide: paid gallery, free gallery or call for donations.
exhibit.quote: “My gallery is open day and night, to the whole world.”

peinture.title: Painting
peinture.intro: Acrylic, oil, batik, mosaic: the colour and gesture of Africa’s painters, hung in the bright halls of their villas.

photographie.title: Photography
photographie.intro: Faces, markets, the light of the Sahel: the eye of the continent’s photographers, in fine-art prints and limited editions.

sculpture.title: Sculpture
sculpture.intro: Ebony, bronze, clay: powerful forms, heirs to ancient craftsmanship, to discover on their pedestals.
